title: Daily Life - Planning a Bank Robbery
audio: mp3/56. Daily Life - Planning a Bank Robbery.mp3

segments.en: Hello everyone, welcome back to EnglishPod.
And today we're going to be bringing you a great lesson that's talking about a bank robbery.
segments.zh: 今天我们将为您带来一节很棒的课程，讲的是银行抢劫。

segments.en: Yes, and this is an important lesson for all of our future bank robbers out there.
segments.zh: 是的，这节课对我们所有未来的银行劫匪来说都很重要。

segments.en: Yeah, we are going to teach you some words that you would use for planning a bank robbery, but you can apply them to other situations, hopefully not.
segments.zh: 是的，我们将教您一些用于计划银行抢劫案的单词，但您可以将它们应用于其他情况，希望不会。

segments.en: Yeah, I hope you apply them to other situations.
segments.zh: 是的，我希望你将它们应用于其他情况。

segments.en: Hopefully you won't rob a bank.
We don't want to be responsible for any crimes you can commit.
segments.zh: 我们不想对您可能犯下的任何罪行负责。

segments.en: Alright, so why don't we start by looking at some of the vocabulary in Vocabulary Preview.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们为什么不从词汇预览中的一些词汇开始。

segments.en: We have one word for you today that you'll hear in the dialogue and it is filling in.
segments.zh: 今天有一个词你会在对话里听到，那就是 filling in。

segments.en: So to fill in for somebody, right?
segments.zh: 所以 to fill in for somebody，就是替某人代班，对吧？

segments.en: That means that you are replacing them.
segments.zh: 这意味着您正在更换它们。

segments.en: So if Marco can't host the show today, maybe Daini will fill in.
segments.zh: 所以如果马可今天不能主持节目，也许 Daini 会来代班。

segments.en: Okay, so to take the place of someone.
Okay, so now let's listen to our dialogue.
segments.zh: 好的，现在让我们听听我们的对话。

segments.en: Let's listen to this bank robbery and let's see what happens.
segments.zh: 让我们听听这场银行抢劫案，让我们看看会发生什么。

segments.en: Alright, so this is what we're going to do.
segments.zh: 好吧，这就是我们要做的。

segments.en: I've carefully mapped this out, so don't screw it up.
segments.zh: 我已经把计划安排得很周密了，别搞砸。

segments.en: Mr. Rabbit, you and Mr. Fox will go to the bank wearing these uniforms.
segments.zh: 兔子先生、狐狸先生，你们穿着这身制服去银行。

segments.en: We've managed to get replicas of the one the guards wear for when they pick up the money.
segments.zh: 我们弄到了运钞保安制服的仿制品。

segments.en: When you get inside, tell them that you're filling in for Carl and Tom and say that they're on another route today.
segments.zh: 进去以后就说你们今天替卡尔和汤姆值班，他们跑另一条运钞路线。

segments.en: What if they want to call and confirm?
segments.zh: 要是他们打电话核实呢？

segments.en: We have the phones tapped, so the call will be passed through to me and I'll pretend to be the transport company.
segments.zh: 我们已经在电话线上做了手脚，电话会转到我这儿，我会冒充押运公司。

segments.en: Only take as much money as you can fit in these bags.
segments.zh: 这些袋子能装多少就拿多少。

segments.en: Well, it sounds like a pretty interesting plan.
segments.zh: 好吧，这听起来像是一个非常有趣的计划。

segments.en: It does sound like a plan.
segments.zh: 这听起来确实像一个计划。

segments.en: I guess we'll have to maybe talk a little bit about that later.
segments.zh: 我想我们稍后得再聊聊这个。

segments.en: Let's take a look at the language that we saw in Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 让我们来看看我们在语言要点中看到的语言。

segments.en: Okay, we heard five really great words in this dialogue that I'd like to look at now in Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 好的，我们在这个对话中听到了五个非常棒的词，我现在想在语言要点中看到它们。

segments.en: So let's go to the first one.
Now we heard the boss say that they got replicas of the uniforms.
segments.zh: 现在我们听到老板说他们得到了制服的复制品。

segments.en: Something that's a replica is a copy.
segments.zh: replica 就是复制品、仿制品。

segments.en: So for example, in Las Vegas, there's a replica of the Eiffel Tower of Paris.
segments.zh: 例如，在拉斯维加斯，有一个巴黎埃菲尔铁塔的复制品。

segments.en: Actually, I lived in a small city where there was also a replica of the Eiffel Tower.
segments.zh: 实际上，我住在一个小城市，那里还有埃菲尔铁塔的复制品。

segments.en: Well, there are a lot of replicas.
Even now on the street, maybe you can see replica watches, right?
segments.zh: 甚至现在在街上，你可能看到仿牌手表，对吧？

segments.en: That supposedly are Rolex, but they're not.
segments.zh: 据说是劳力士，但事实并非如此。
还有很多很多其他的东西。

segments.en: All right, so let's take a look at the next word.
segments.zh: 好吧，让我们来看看下一个词。
我们已经把电话窃听了。
我们已经把电话窃听了。

segments.en: So if you tap someone's phone, you do something to the telephone line so that you can hear their conversations, right?
segments.zh: 所以如果你 tap 某人的电话，就是对电话线做手脚，好听到他们的通话，对吧？

segments.en: And actually, the police do this sometimes, right?
segments.zh: 实际上，警察有时会这样做，对吧？

segments.en: You see it in movies all the time.
segments.zh: 你总是在电影中看到它。

segments.en: You connect a wire to the phone so you can listen to the conversation.
segments.zh: 你在电话上接一根线，这样就能偷听通话。

segments.en: So, you tap the telephone line.
segments.zh: 所以，你就是窃听电话线。

segments.en: So in our dialogue, they tapped the bank's phone, right?
segments.zh: 所以在对话里，他们窃听了银行的电话，对吧？

segments.en: And he said if they make a call, he will patch the call through to him.
segments.zh: 他说如果他们打电话，他会把电话转接到他那里。

segments.en: Like if you call an office, right?
segments.zh: 就像你打电话给办公室一样，对吧？

segments.en: And you say, oh, can you patch me through to Carol?
segments.zh: 你说，哦，能帮我转接给 Carol 吗？

segments.en: So, can you connect me to another phone line?
segments.zh: 也就是，你能帮我接到另一个电话上吗？

segments.en: Now, let's take a look at our next words.
segments.zh: 现在，让我们来看看我们的下一个词。

segments.en: Yes, the boss is very clever.
So, you're clever and this is a clever plan.
segments.zh: 所以，你很聪明，这是一个聪明的计划。

segments.en: Now, let's take a look at our last word.
segments.zh: 现在，让我们来看看我们的最后一句话。

segments.en: To be greedy is a bad thing.

segments.zh: 你想把什么都据为己有。

segments.en: So, like at lunch today, when you had that cake.
segments.zh: 就像今天午饭时，你吃着那块蛋糕。

segments.en: So, these are some great words.
segments.zh: 所以，这些是一些很棒的词。

segments.en: And I think, you know, if we listen to the dialogue another time, a little bit more slowly, we'll be able to hear them a little bit better.
segments.zh: 我想，你知道，如果我们再听一次对话，慢一点，我们就能更好地听到他们的声音。

segments.en: So this is what we're going to do.
segments.zh: 所以这就是我们要做的。
我已经仔细规划了这个。

segments.en: Mr. Rabbit, you and Mr. Fox will go into the bank wearing these uniforms.
segments.zh: 兔子先生、你和福克斯先生会穿着这些制服进入银行。

segments.en: We've managed to get replicas of the one the guards wear when they pick up the money.
segments.zh: 我们弄到了那些警卫取钱时穿的制服的仿制品。

segments.en: When you get inside, tell them that you're filling in for Carl and Tom and say that they're on another route today.
segments.zh: 进去以后就说你们今天替卡尔和汤姆值班，他们跑另一条运钞路线。

segments.en: What if they want to call and conform?
segments.zh: 要是他们打电话来核实呢？
我们已经把电话窃听了。

segments.en: So the call will be patched through to me.
segments.zh: 所以电话会转接到我这里。

segments.en: And I'll pretend to be the transport company.
Only take as much money as you can fit into these bags.
segments.zh: 只拿尽可能多的钱装进这些包里。

segments.en: Okay, so now we understand these words that we talked about in Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 好的，现在我们理解了我们在语言要点中谈到的这些词。

segments.en: So now let's take a look at some of these great phrases in Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 所以现在让我们来看看流利表达中的一些很棒的短语。

segments.en: We've got three phrases for you here.
segments.zh: 我们在这里为您准备了三个短语。

segments.en: And these are all phrases you might use when you're planning something.
segments.zh: 这些都是您在计划某事时可能使用的所有短语。

segments.en: So the first one, mapped out.
segments.zh: 所以第一个，mapped out（规划、制定）。
我已经仔细规划了这个。

segments.en: So when you map something out, what do you do?
segments.zh: 那么当你 map out 一件事的时候，是做什么呢？

segments.en: Well, you literally create a plan.
segments.zh: 好吧，您确实创建了一个计划。

segments.en: You draw a map of what you're going to do.
segments.zh: 你画出你要做什么的地图。

segments.en: So here, is it only for like travel or?
segments.zh: 所以在这里，它只是为了旅行还是？

segments.en: It's like, for example, if we're starting a new project in the company, you can map out the project, what you're going to do this month, next month.
segments.zh: 例如，如果我们在公司开始一个新项目，您可以规划该项目，您本月将要做什么，下个月。

segments.en: So you draw every step in the plan.
segments.zh: 所以你在计划中画出每一步。

segments.en: So you said, well, I've mapped out this plan for a new project.
segments.zh: 所以你说，好吧，我已经为一个新项目制定了这个计划。

segments.en: I think we should hear some examples of how it's used.
segments.zh: 我认为我们应该听到一些关于它如何使用的例子。

segments.en: So I have the future all mapped out.
segments.zh: 所以我把未来都规划好了。

segments.en: Well, you'll get a job as a waiter, then we'll get married.
segments.zh: 好吧，你会找到一份服务员的工作，然后我们就结婚了。

segments.en: And two years later, we'll start having kids.
segments.zh: 两年后，我们将开始生孩子。

segments.en: We're mapping out the marketing plan at the meeting today.
segments.zh: 我们今天在会议上制定营销计划。

segments.en: Okay, I've mapped out our trip and it should take about 10 hours.
segments.zh: 好的，我已经规划好了我们的旅行，应该需要大约 10 个小时。

segments.en: Let's take a look at our next word.
All right, so if you've mapped out a plan, you don't want to screw it up.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以如果你制定了一个计划，你不想把它搞砸。

segments.en: So to screw something up means that you made a mistake on something.
segments.zh: 所以把事情搞砸意味着你在某事上犯了一个错误。

segments.en: Okay, so for example, if I'm taking an exam and I make a mistake, I screwed up on the exam.
segments.zh: 好吧，例如，如果我正在参加考试并且犯了一个错误，我就搞砸了考试。

segments.en: Or for example, here, when we're recording, Marco and I make mistakes a lot.
segments.zh: 或者例如，在这里，当我们录制时，Marco 和我经常犯错误。
也许我犯的错比马可还多。

segments.en: So to make a mistake, it's a really informal word, but very, very common.
segments.zh: 所以犯错，这是一个非常非正式的词，但非常非常常见。

segments.en: And you know, it sounds really, really natural when people use this.
segments.zh: 你知道，当人们使用它时，这听起来非常非常自然。

segments.en: All right, so now let's take a look at our last word.
segments.zh: 好吧，现在让我们来看看我们的最后一个词。

segments.en: So what is this, to lose your cool?
segments.zh: 那么这是什么，失去你的冷静？

segments.en: Why don't we just give you an example of a person that loses his or her cool.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不给你一个失去冷静的人的例子。

segments.en: What do you mean you're not ready to go?
segments.zh: 你说你还没准备好出发是什么意思？

segments.en: Punietta, now we're sitting here again.
segments.zh: Punietta，现在我们又坐在这里了。

segments.en: I'm going to wait for you.
Okay, so basically, you lose your temper.
segments.zh: 好吧，基本上，你发脾气了。

segments.en: You lose control of your emotions.
segments.zh: 你失去了对情绪的控制。

segments.en: So Marco, when you lose your cool, is it always that you get angry?
segments.zh: 所以马可，当你失去冷静时，你总是生气吗？

segments.en: Maybe you get irritated or impatient.
segments.zh: 也许你会生气或不耐烦。

segments.en: So basically, you're not in control of your emotions.
segments.zh: 所以基本上，你无法控制自己的情绪。

segments.en: Okay, so we've looked at a lot of great phrases, a lot of great words.
segments.zh: 好的，所以我们看了很多很棒的短语，很多很棒的词。

segments.en: So we can listen to our dialogue now for the third time, and then we'll come back and talk about this bank robbery business.
segments.zh: 所以我们现在可以第三次听我们的对话，然后我们会回来谈论这个银行抢劫业务。

segments.en: All right, so this is what we're going to do.
segments.zh: 好吧，这就是我们要做的。

segments.en: I've carefully mapped this out, so don't screw it up.
segments.zh: 我已经把计划安排得很周密了，别搞砸。

segments.en: Mr. Rabbit, you and Mr. Fox will go to the bank wearing these uniforms.
segments.zh: 兔子先生、狐狸先生，你们穿着这身制服去银行。

segments.en: We've managed to get replicas of the one the guards wear for when they pick up the money.
segments.zh: 我们弄到了运钞保安制服的仿制品。

segments.en: When you get inside, tell them that you're filling in for Carl and Tom, and say that they're on another route today.
segments.zh: 进去以后就说你们是替卡尔和汤姆代班的，说他们今天跑另一条路线。

segments.en: What if they want to call and confirm?
segments.zh: 要是他们打电话核实呢？

segments.en: We have the phones tapped, so the call will be patched through to me, and I'll pretend to be the transport company.
segments.zh: 我们已经窃听了电话，通话会转接到我这里，我会冒充押运公司。

segments.en: Only take as much money as you can fit in these bags.
segments.zh: 这些袋子能装多少就拿多少。

segments.en: So there's a lot of movies about bank robberies, but obviously they happen in real life.
segments.zh: 所以有很多关于银行抢劫的电影，但显然它们发生在现实生活中。

segments.en: So this dialogue is actually based on real events, right?
segments.zh: 所以这个对话实际上是基于真实的事件，对吧？

segments.en: Yeah, this actually happened in real life, and so it's actually a very creative and nonviolent way of robbing a bank.
segments.zh: 是的，这实际上发生在现实生活中，所以它实际上是一种非常有创意和非暴力的抢劫银行的方式。

segments.en: Basically, this guy went to a bank dressed up as one of those security guards that transport the money from the bank to another safe place.
segments.zh: 基本上，这家伙装扮成那种把钱从银行运到另一个安全地点的保安。

segments.en: He had fake credentials or replica credentials.
segments.zh: 他有假证件，或者说仿造的证件。

segments.en: Yeah, he had a replica of the uniform.
segments.zh: 是的，他有制服的复制品。

segments.en: And he walked in, he took all these bags, him and his partner, and they took him to the truck and drove off.
segments.zh: 他走进去，拿上所有这些袋子，他和搭档把袋子搬上卡车，然后开走了。

segments.en: The bank didn't realize that they had been robbed.
segments.zh: 银行没有意识到他们被抢劫了。

segments.en: They thought it was a routine thing.
segments.zh: 他们认为这是一个常规的事情。

segments.en: Three or four hours later, the real security guard shows up.
segments.zh: 三四个小时后，真正的保安出现了。

segments.en: They were long gone, and they still can't find them.
segments.zh: 他们早就跑远了，直到现在都没找到。
所以一个非常聪明的计划。

segments.en: I think they stole over half a million dollars.
segments.zh: 我觉得他们偷了五十多万美元。

segments.en: Okay, well guys, don't try this at home.
segments.zh: 好吧，伙计们，不要在家里尝试这个。

segments.en: Don't try this at home, but real life, real English, right?
segments.zh: 不要在家里尝试这个，而是在现实生活中，真正的英语，对吧？

segments.en: Okay, so come to our website, leave your questions and comments.
segments.zh: 好的，请访问我们的网站，留下您的问题和意见。

segments.en: Tell us what you think will happen with these guys.
segments.zh: 告诉我们你认为这些人会发生什么。

segments.en: Do you think they'll be successful?
Do you think they'll get caught?
segments.zh: 你认为他们会被抓住吗？

segments.en: Yeah, they might end up in jail.
segments.zh: 是的，他们可能最终会入狱。

segments.en: Maybe somebody will lose their cool and get caught, right?
segments.zh: 也许有人会失去冷静并被抓住，对吧？

segments.en: Well thanks for listening guys, and until next time, goodbye.
segments.zh: 好吧，感谢大家的聆听，直到下一次，再见。
